verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy documents a public API and programmatic webhook registration for subscription events. It also has a built-in dunning system with card retries and customer emails. That covers monitoring and automated recovery, but nothing shows a specific failed-payment event, and nothing shows an agent triggering retries or dunning outreach through the API rather than relying on built-in automation. Missing for 10: a documented payment-failed webhook event, API endpoints to trigger or control retries and dunning emails, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: Using the API, you can set up webhooks and subscribe to events programatically.
We’ll also explain in depth how to use our API to handle common checkout and subscription-related events.
Lemon Squeezy offers a **powerful dunning management system** to combat involuntary churn from subscriptions, card retries, and customer emails.
